name: CAP command scarf (optional; worn with the FDU and CFDU)
size_basis: Two bands lying along the FDU collar V and crossing where they are tucked in; sized to the suit's collar opening. CAPR 39-1 8.2.6 / Figure 8.2 give no dimensions. Motif is an original simplified three-pronged mark, not traced.
landmarks_note: Optional accessory. Place so anchors.suit_apex coincides with the suit's anchors.collar_apex (both in the same inch scale).
documented: yellow and red CAP command scarf is authorized with the FDU (8.2.6) and CFDU (8.3.6), worn around the neck and tucked into the flight suit
